title: Recap: Verbs That Happen By Themselves

sections.title: Natural Processes with -ódik/-ődik and Intransitive Stems
sections.content: You know from A2 Unit 31 that Hungarian often uses a verb that 'happens by itself' (*elromlik*, *megoldódik*) where English would use a passive. Many changes in nature are described this way: *a folyó szennyeződik* ('the river becomes polluted'), *a természet megújul* ('nature renews itself'), *eltűnik az erdő* ('the forest disappears').

items.spanish: Tavasszal a természet csodálatos módon megújul.
items.english: In spring nature renews itself in a wonderful way.

items.spanish: A nem kezelt szennyvíz miatt a természetes élőhely gyorsan pusztul.
items.english: Due to untreated wastewater the natural habitat is rapidly degrading.
